Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Glass Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the incident on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim for glass repair has been approved.

This loss is covered under your comprehensive coverage. Specifically, your policy states: "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations." Additionally, the policy notes that "Repair of a windshield chip without replacement is paid with no deductible."

Regarding your payment, the payment to the claimant is {PAYOUT}. Please note that no deductible applies to this claim.

As a next step, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions, please contact us at the number provided on your policy documents.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
